stem: Thomas would like to provide a better transition between the fifth paragraph (sentences 20–24) and the sixth paragraph (sentences 25–30). Which of the following should replace sentence 25 to achieve this goal?

options.label: F
options.text: One day my brother and I hiked down the cliffs into the basin to explore the stream.

options.label: G
options.text: Then my brother and I hurried to visit the stream to see the flowing water.

options.label: H
options.text: After a while my brother and I decided to go hiking, and we traveled to the stream.

options.label: J
options.text: In the meantime my brother and I thought it would be fun to explore the stream.
